officialSources.observation: Official government directory lists the Settlement and Land Records Department at slrd.gov.mm. This establishes the national agency pointer, not a Myitkyina-local public parcel service.
Official SLRD English landing page is identified by search, but direct GET returned a Cloudflare challenge. No login, CAPTCHA solving, or bypass was attempted.
Official Survey Department landing page describes production and distribution of topographic maps. It does not expose a Myitkyina parcel layer or anonymous parcel API.
Official Burmese Survey Department page describes UTM/topographic mapping work and scales; it is general surveying evidence, not cadastral parcel geometry for Myitkyina.
Official Ministry page mentions Myitkyina township in a fisheries/agricultural activity report only; no registry, cadastral map, parcel ID, or geometry is provided.

requests.outcome: Direct HTTPS request returned a Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge). No challenge defeat, credentials, or private token was used. This is an access limitation, not evidence of absence.
Government directory reviewed; SLRD is listed as a national department. No city-specific parcel route or API was exposed.
Survey Department landing page reviewed; general topographic map production/distribution information only. No parcel response obtained.
Burmese surveying page reviewed; UTM/topographic mapping scope and map scales documented, but no cadastral vector layer or Myitkyina parcel geometry.
Myitkyina township reference reviewed; it concerns fisheries activity and is not a cadastral or land-registry source.
